_comment: The party leaderboard's idles and once-lines (tools/hall-private/npcs/drafting/board_approved.json). idles: NPC -> near (game units from AGHallLeaderBoardWriteMarker) and lines, played ahead of the NPC's own idles while that near the board. once: said once, ahead of the NPC's hellos, when the player's party holds 'place' on the board (AG_LB_PlayerPlaceGlobal). late: Marius's (voiced 2026-11-05), made after the others so no recorded line moves; with no idles or hellos of his own they go at the end of those topics. renownAbove: said once when the party's Renown (AG_LB_PartyRenownGlobal) passes that score (433, the Cold Hearth's on the board).

lines.boardIdle1: I deserve better than this. I'll talk with them later.

topOfBoard.text: Your party's at the top of the board. The Frostbitten held it all these years. They'd be proud of you and what you've done for this land.

lines.boardIdle2: Still behind the Frostbitten. Don't see that ever changing.

topOfBoard.text: Top of the board. I never thought I'd live to see anyone above the Frostbitten. Well done.

passedColdHearth.text: So. Your lot passed the Cold Hearth. Good. Took you long enough.
